3. The suit was contested by defendant No.1 stating, inter alia, that Sadek Ali had 7 annas interest in the land of D.S. Khatian No. 127, that Sadek Ali died leaving 5 sons including the plaintiff, a daughter and a widow, that the said heirs of Sadek Ali mortgaged the land inherited by them to Loni Miah and Foiz Boksha and that mortgage was foreclosed by the mortgagee instituting Suit No. 41 of 1920 in the 2nd Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Laxmipur and on the basis of the decree obtained in the said Suit Execution Case No. 178 of 1920 was instituted and the land was put to auction and the same was purchased by Loni Miah and Foiz Boksha and they obtained possession, that by the said auction sale plaintiff and the other heirs of Sadek Ali lost their interest in the land of D.S. Khatian No. 127, that Loni Miah by the kabala dated Judge 27, 1992 sold his share to Ahammad Ali Patwary and Akhter Jahan, that 3 annas 10 gondas share of Bibi Jan, one of the recorded tenants of D.S. Khatian No. 127 was purchased by defendant No. 1's father, Ahammad Ali Patwary on October 1, 1948, that share of Fuljan, Rajab Ali and others, the recorded tenants of D.S. Khatian No. 127 was purchased by different defendants, that plaintiffs having had lost their interest in the land of D.S. Khatian No. 127, they on January 19, 1955 took lease of 6 decimals of land of Plot No. 349 from the defendant No.1 and Abdus Samad by executing kabuliy'at and they are enjoying said 6 decimals of land, that plaintiffs are not co-sharers of the land in suit and as such their suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 8. The High Court Division made the Rule absolute on the finding that there is no dispute that the land in suit (2.78 acres) seeking partition whereof suit has been filed claiming separate saham of 96¼ decimals of land inherited by the plaintiffs from Sadek Ali but the defendants' side denied the claim of the plaintiffs contending that Sadek Ali's heirs mortgaged the land and the mortgagee foreclosed the mortgaged land by instituting suit and in execution of the decree obtained in the suit purchased the land left by Sadek Ali and thus Sadek Ali's heirs lost their right, title and interest in the land of D.S. Khatian No. 127. It may be mentioned the defendants auction purchase relates to the land of mouza Avirampur but the plaintiffs have filed the suit seeking partition of the land of mouza Angarpara. The sale certificate Ext. Ka filed from the side of the defendant No.1 shows that the same relates to the land of mouza Avirampur. The High Court Division discarded the case of the defendant No.1 that plaintiffs took settlement of 6 decimals of land from the defendants since no evidence was brought on record in support of the said case of the defendants. It has also been observed by the High Court Division, on perusal of the materials on record, that from the defendant's side no material was brought on record to establish that the land in suit was previously of mouza Avirampur and that during the subsequent district settlement survey the land of the said mouza Avirampur was listed in mouza Angarpara.
